pages.title: Reading Hebrew
pages.summary: Letters and their final forms, vowel points, the dot that changes b/v k/ch p/f, and modern 'full' spelling. Plus where the keys are.

pages.title: Roots & binyanim
pages.summary: How three-letter roots plus seven verb patterns build almost every Hebrew verb — and how to spot the pattern.

pages.title: Pa'al
pages.summary: The basic binyan: כָּתַב, כּוֹתֵב, יִכְתּוֹב. Full tables, how people really use it, and the common irregular verbs.

pages.title: Pi'el
pages.summary: The doubled-middle binyan: דִּיבֵּר, מְדַבֵּר, יְדַבֵּר. Where slang verbs like לְסַמֵּס and לְפַרְגֵּן live.

pages.title: How people actually talk
pages.summary: שלי instead of suffixes, commands in the future tense, 'עשרים שקל', אצלי, כזה — the gap between the textbook and the street.
